create.name: Dr. Rajan Sankaran
create.bio:
Rajan Sankaran graduated from CMP Homeopathic Medical College in Mumbai and went on to teach there as associate professor for twenty-five years, later taking an MD in homeopathy from Aurangabad University. He has been in practice and teaching for more than four decades, and is the figure most responsible for the direction homeopathic thinking has taken since the 1990s.

His contribution is a sequence of conceptual moves that each reframed the case: disease as delusion, the classification of remedies by kingdom — plant, mineral, animal — and then the "Sensation" method, in which the practitioner works to reach what he describes as the non-human-specific experience underneath a patient's story. His schema of levels, from name and fact down to sensation and energy, is now taught in schools that have no other connection to him. He has taught in more than twenty-five countries.

He heads the other song — The International Academy of Advanced Homeopathy in Mumbai, and runs his clinic in the same city. His books run to more than twenty-five professional titles, and in recent years he has written for a general readership too — From Pattern to Presence and When Skill Meets Soul are addressed to anyone interested in awareness and inner work rather than to homeopaths. Alongside this he teaches meditation, sings Indian classical raga, and has developed Raga Therapy, applying what he calls homeopathic principles to Indian classical music.

books.title: The Spirit of Homoeopathy
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: The book that made his name and changed how a generation of homeopaths took cases. Sankaran sets out his idea that what presents as illness can be read as a "delusion" — a fixed inner posture the person holds toward the world — and shows how he works back from the story to that central state.

books.title: The Substance of Homeopathy
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: The companion volume to The Spirit, where he develops the kingdom classification — plant, mineral, animal — that now underpins much of contemporary prescribing. Densely worked with cases, and treated as a core text on advanced courses worldwide.

books.title: The Soul of Remedies
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: Short, vivid portraits of around a hundred remedies, each written as the central feeling or situation Sankaran associates with it. Practitioners often describe it as the most readable book he has written — the one that makes a remedy picture stick.

books.title: The Sensation in Homoeopathy
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: His full statement of the Sensation method, in which he teaches practitioners to listen past the words to a bodily experience he holds to be shared between the patient and the remedy. This is the book the "Sankaran school" is built on.

books.title: Sensation Refined
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: A return to the method after years of teaching it, correcting the places he felt students were going wrong and tightening the process into something more reproducible. Best read after The Sensation in Homoeopathy rather than instead of it.

books.title: An Insight into Plants (Vol. 1)
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: A systematic mapping of the plant kingdom by family, in which he links botanical relationship to the sensations he associates with each group. The volumes are reference works — the sort practitioners keep open on the desk during a case.

books.title: Homeopathy for Today's World: Discovering Your Animal, Mineral, or Plant Nature
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: His book for the general reader, published by Healing Arts Press. He explains the kingdom framework in plain language and invites the reader to recognise their own nature in it. The most widely distributed of his titles in the West, and the natural entry point for a Spiritpedia audience.

books.title: The Other Song: Discovering Your Parallel Self
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: The book his academy is named after. Sankaran describes what he calls the parallel self — the other song playing under the one we consciously sing — and argues that bringing it into awareness is where healing begins. More philosophical than clinical.

books.title: Sankaran's Plant Sensations in Pictures
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: A visual companion to the plant work, pairing each family's sensation with imagery designed to make it memorable. Built as a teaching aid for students who find the written schema abstract.

books.title: Structure — Vol. 2: Experiences with the Mineral Kingdom
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: His extended treatment of mineral remedies, organised by the periodic-table logic of structure and relationship. Written for practitioners already working inside his framework.

books.title: From Shadow to Light
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: A case-driven book on the art of the consultation itself — how he opens a case, where he presses, and what he listens for as a patient moves from surface account to something more exposed.

books.title: Schema 2.0
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: The updated reference version of his schema — the grid of kingdoms, families and levels that students use to place a case. Essentially a working tool rather than a book to read through.

books.title: Superclasses in Homeopathy
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: A recent extension of the plant classification upward into broader groupings, aimed at practitioners who already work with families and subclasses and want a wider frame.

books.title: The Art of Follow-Up
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: On the part of practice least written about — what to do at the second and third consultation, how he reads change, and when he holds rather than changes the prescription.

books.title: From Pattern to Presence: How to Stop Reacting and Start Living
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: Written for a general audience rather than for homeopaths. Sankaran takes the same idea he applies in the consulting room — that we each run a fixed reactive pattern — and turns it into a practice of noticing and stepping out of it.

books.title: When Skill Meets Soul: How Doctors Become Healers
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: His most recent book, on what he believes separates technical competence from healing. Addressed to clinicians of any discipline, and the title currently featured on his own site.

books.title: Monks, Monkeys and Memories: Reflections on Life's Journey
books.author: Rajan Sankaran
books.description: A memoir-in-essays, ranging over his teachers, his travels and the turns his thinking took. The most personal thing he has published.

courses.title: The Sankaran Masterclass (Levels 1–6)
courses.description: His flagship training — over 185 hours of recorded lectures and case illustrations covering the full Sensation method from theory to application, sold as six progressive levels. Enrolment also carries access to live interactive sessions in which he answers participants' questions directly.

courses.title: Remedies With Rajan (Seasons 1–9)
courses.description: A long-running series in which Sankaran works through remedies season by season, each season a self-contained set of sessions. Practitioners tend to buy seasons as they go rather than all at once.

courses.title: The Gurukul — Advanced Homeopathic Practitioner Programme
courses.description: A one-year hybrid programme, part online and part in person, modelled on the traditional Indian gurukul relationship between teacher and student. Aimed at young practising homeopaths, and built to combine classical repertory work with his sensation and kingdom approaches.

courses.title: Master Course in Advanced Homeopathy — Hybrid Edition
courses.description: The academy's principal advanced qualification, delivered in a mixed online and in-person format from Mumbai, drawing on Sankaran and the wider faculty at the other song.

courses.title: Basic Course in Homeopathy (24 sessions, online)
courses.description: The academy's entry-level online programme, twenty-four sessions covering foundational principles before a student moves toward the advanced modules.

courses.title: 12-Day Online Advanced Course (Modules 1–4)
courses.description: Four twelve-day modules taken together, moving through case-taking foundations, the plant kingdom, the mineral kingdom and the animal kingdom. Available individually or as the combined bundle.

courses.title: The Sankaran Solution — 5 Fingers. One Remedy
courses.description: His newest course, currently listed as upcoming on the academy's front page. Presented as a condensed, five-step route to the remedy for practitioners who find the full schema unwieldy.

courses.title: HOPEflix (course library)
courses.description: The academy's on-demand store, where his recorded courses, seasons and bundles sit together. Functions as the standing library for practitioners following his teaching.
